method: Ran the dependency-free audit script against the lesson. It compiled every Python fence, inspected the first-round scenario list, executed only the local mock sink functions, and asserted historical-result and injection-scope qualifications plus the linked OWASP source.
limitations: No historical provider request/response or complete three-round script was available; the 0/7 summary and its denominator were not reproduced.
The script checks lesson statements and local mock behavior, not model resistance, production authorization, approval flows, parameter allowlists, or tool execution.

OWASP guidance supports impact mitigation; the explanation that indirect injection also affects ordinary RAG/document LLM applications is an application of the threat definition, not an exclusive formal taxonomy.
